definition: an outer garment covering the lower body, with a separate section for each leg
hook: Every pair of pants you own is named after one actor's costume.
modernAnchor: We pull on a pair every morning without a thought for the costume behind the word.

origin.originalMeaning: a miserly old Venetian merchant in Italian comic theater

journey: Italian comic theater staged Pantalone, a miserly old Venetian merchant chasing money and young wives.
Every actor playing him wore the same costume, tight ankle-length trousers unlike anyone else on stage.
The character crossed into France and England, and the trousers became known as pantaloons.
Pantaloons shortened to pants. We still name our trousers after one comic stage merchant.
